async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Click the first 'Sales' link to avoid ambiguity
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Sales").first.click()
    # Wait for page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Step 2: On the Sales page, click the 'Orders' link
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Orders").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Step 3: On the Orders page, find the status combobox and select 'Processing'
    await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status").select_option("Processing")
    # Step 4: Click the 'Search' button to apply the filter
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Step 5: Retrieve the raw HTML of the orders table
    orders_table_html = await page.inner_html("table")
    return orders_table_html
